g.text: Weighted mean annual earnings by five-year age band (red), over every individual earner (grey)
Average earnings more than triple between the late teens and the late fifties
Source: PSLM 2019-20 person file. Sample: 3,768 earners (ages 15-64, annual earnings > 0) in urban Punjab. Means weighted by hhweight.
Grey points jittered by up to 0.4 years. Filled markers: bands with 30+ earners; hollow markers would mark thin bands (< 30).
25 earners outside the axis range are not drawn but are included in the means.
